svg.aria-label: What ships with bkit, one coloured row per phase. Design: three rival designs, probe code for the risky unknowns, reads your history, reviewed for failure modes. Plan: one review round, self-contained tasks, learns from past bugs and postponed work, more than 30 audits. Build: test first and verified, hunts bugs and security holes, checks the plan is still current, skills on demand. Debug: outside evidence from CI and your platforms, root cause first, hard-bug mode, knows when to stop. Ship: honest CI, nothing quietly dropped, docs and memory, never touches main. Every phase: any AI tool, best model per job, independent review, laptop to cloud.
